requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep evidence gaps open when links lack adequate results and refuse to simulate design review or approval evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill separates link coverage from evidence sufficiency and requires review/approval states to remain referenced evidence rather than simulated states.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep concrete confidential design artifacts and current baselines out of global durable memory
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Memory Path keeps concrete specifications, technical details, current baselines, and open V&V results in run or controlled project/quality records.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: equate traceability coverage with adequate evidence or effectiveness
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Requirement ≠ evidence and the gap taxonomy explicitly keep coverage, evidence, and effectiveness distinct.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent approvals or persist confidential design specifications as reusable global memory
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Approvals are not simulated and confidential design artifacts are explicitly excluded from global durable memory.
